paragraphs.text: None but such can do it, or are fit for it; and for such praise is comely, Psa 147:1, as unthankfulness is an ugly sin, but especially in ministers, those servants of the Lord, by a specialty.
paragraphs.anchor: Praise, O ye servants of the Lord

paragraphs.text: Ter repetit, Trinitatem subindicando, saith one; others note that by this threefold Praise ye, the psalmist taxeth men’s dulness, and exciteth their diligence to this divine duty.
paragraphs.anchor: Praise the name of the Lord

paragraphs.text: Praise him with utmost intention and extension of spirit and of speech. God is therefore called, by an appellative proper, The Blessed One, Baruc-hu, Mar 14:61 Luk 1:68.
paragraphs.anchor: Blessed be the name of the Lord

paragraphs.text: i.e. All the world over, in all places and at all times. North and south are not mentioned (but included), because not so well peopled.
paragraphs.anchor: From the rising of the sun

paragraphs.text: He looketh on the earth as on an ant hill. All nations to him are but as a drop of a bucket, Isa 40:15 Quantilla ergo es tu istius guttae particula? (Aug.).
These are far beneath him in glory as in situation. Angels understand him not fully.
paragraphs.anchor: And his glory above the heavens

paragraphs.text: Heb. Who exalteth to dwell. Oh that we could fly a pitch any way proportionable by exalting his name together, Psa 34:3.
Lo, it is a condescension in God to vouchsafe to look out of himself upon the saints and angels, how much more upon us, since sin setteth us farther beneath a worm than a worm is beneath an angel!
David, for instance, besides many others, as Agathocles, Numa, Maximinianus, &c., whom he raised from the lowest stair to the very highest step of honour and opulence.
See 1Sa 2:8, Hannah’s song, whereof this seemeth to be an abridgment.
paragraphs.anchor: That he may set him with princes

paragraphs.text: Heb. to dwell in a house, that is, to have a house full of children, and so to build her husband’s house, Rth 4:11. This is applied to the Church (which is the theatre of the world, wherein God showeth his special providence and power), Isa 54:1 Gal 4:26-27.
paragraphs.anchor: He maketh the barren woman to keep house
